text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated OOM rate on decode-streaming pool 'decode-prod-3' (node decode-prod-3-7). Spike in request drops and container restarts. https://internal.ops/inc/1719002468

asha_sre: I'm on it — paging eng-runtime and ops. Starting triage.

ben: Looking at logs: repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` during decode loop, container restarted x2 in 5m. Node-level GPU usage tops out before restart.

maria: CS reporting increased 502/504s for tenant acme-inc. Customer impact flagged. Any quick mitigations?

asha_sre: Draining node decode-prod-3-7 now to stop new streams landing there. Will also apply temporary rate-limit for streaming route for tenant `acme-inc`.

ben: Pattern looks like runaway generation from some clients — we've seen `max_tokens` values ~10000 in headers. Our server cap didn't kick in because the header name changed in last deploy.

ryan: Confirmed — recent SDK rename changed header from `x-max-tokens` -> `x-client-max-tokens`. Limiter only read `x-max-tokens`. Clients still sending old name and our fallback was removed.

asha_sre: Hotpatch plan: 1) reintroduce header fallback (accept both), 2) enforce server-side hard cap <= 2048 for streaming requests. Applying patch to limiter pod sets now.

ben: Patch applying. kubectl snippet:```bash
kubectl -n inference set env ds/limiter HEADER_FALLBACK="x-max-tokens,x-client-max-tokens" && \
kubectl -n inference rollout restart daemonset/limiter
```

ben: Also scaling decode-prod pool +2 nodes to absorb backlog: `k scale ds/decode-prod --replicas=$(($(kubectl get ds decode-prod -o jsonpath='{.status.desiredNumberScheduled}')+2))`

incident-bot: Pager note created and linked: https://internal.ops/inc/1719002468. On-call handoff scheduled to night-oncall at ts 1719003600.

nina: CS update: told acme-inc we're investigating, they reported ~40% failed requests over last 15m. Provided initial ETA ~20m and asked for post-incident summary.

asha_sre: Limiter hotpatch applied, server-side cap enforced. Memory graphs show decode-prod-3-7 memory dropping after restart, request drops trending down. Leaving node drained for 10m then will reintroduce.

ben: Creating follow-up work: server-side enforcement (per-route cap), telemetry for header mismatches, and a regression test for header rename. PR: #3421 (WIP).

asha_sre: Action items for postmortem: 1) restore header fallback permanently, 2) add server hard cap + telemetry, 3) update SDK and publish patch, 4) improve alerting to include tenant impact in the first page. Assigning owners in ticket INC-894.

maria: :thumbsup: Great work. Keep me posted, will draft customer update after stable metrics for 30m.

asha_sre: Will follow up in 30m with metrics. Closing on-call bridge once error rate <1% and no OOMs for two consecutive 5m windows.
